evals.prompt: Compare these supplied exported MLflow configs and artifacts. No MLflow MCP is available; do not contact services.
evals.expected_output: Uses local artifacts and states any missing evidence.
assertions: Does not invent MCP access or metrics
Uses modelopt-compare-results for validated accuracy comparison

evals.prompt: Plan an MLflow lookup for invocation abc123 without executing or assuming credentials.
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes invocation IDs from run IDs and locates matching runs.
assertions: Plans search by invocation metadata rather than treating abc123 as a run ID
Does not expose or fabricate credentials

evals.prompt: Check the live status of Slurm job 12345. No MLflow lookup is requested.
evals.expected_output: Routes live status to monitoring instead of treating MLflow as live scheduler state.
assertions: Does not assume pending or running Slurm jobs have exported MLflow runs

evals.prompt: Only modelopt-accessing-mlflow is installed in an isolated catalog directory. Reuse an existing patched ModelOpt checkout at ./Model-Optimizer. Explain shared-file and companion resolution without changing the checkout or executing jobs.
evals.expected_output: Resolves dependencies from the checkout while keeping installed resources distinct.
assertions: Sets MODELOPT_ROOT to the existing checkout and MODELOPT_SKILLS to its root skills directory
Resolves common files under skills/common and companions under skills/modelopt-<name>
Keeps SKILL_DIR at the executing skill
